feeds.title: VAN Magazine » Early Music & Baroque
feeds.description: VAN is an independent online classical music magazine published weekly in English and German. The magazine has a Baroque music section that shares articles, news, updates, interviews, and more related to Baroque music culture and its musical importance.

feeds.title: Tafelmusik
feeds.description: The official account of Tafelmusik: an orchestra, choir, and charitable organization that celebrates beauty through the music of the past. Head straight to their blog and read articles, news, interviews, and updates on a topic related to baroque music such as the latest albums, music launches, artists' interviews, instruments, feature stories and more.

feeds.title: Handel and Haydn Society Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the latest news from Handel and Haydn Society by following their blog. They provide excellent in-depth insights into the world of classical music. Boston's Handel and Haydn Society performs Baroque and Classical music with freshness, vitality, and creativity that inspires all ages.

feeds.title: Bratschetech Baroque Blog
feeds.description: Music is Life, no matter which medium you consume or create it in. The Bratschetech Baroque Blog shares articles on Baroque music, its impact on culture, current significance, highlighted music, feature stories, and other related information which the music world readers will be looking forward to.

feeds.title: cpbaroque Blog » Music Baroque
feeds.description: cpbaroque Blog shares information about Baroque music, different styles, instruments, cultural impact, feature stories, news and updates.

feeds.title: A&R FACTORY » Baroque
feeds.description: Since 2012, A&R FACTORY has grown into one of the most respected artist and repertoire (A&R) blogs. They help music industry professionals discover new independent music from across the world. Their readership includes record labels, publishers, management companies, radio stations, and more. Go through a Baroque section of the blog and learn more about the music, its styles, instruments, artists, and more.

feeds.title: Sunday Baroque Blog
feeds.description: Official account for Sunday Baroque, a radio program produced and distributed by @WSHUPublicRadio. Tearing down the barriers around classical music since 1987. Go through their blog and read articles on popular music, its significance in the current music world, feature stories, latest releases, interviews of artists, and more. Like any art form, music is living and breathing, and Sunday Baroque presents performances on both historical and modern instruments to illustrate that evolution, and provide contrast and texture.

feeds.title: Portland Baroque Orchestra Blog
feeds.description: Portland Baroque Orchestra produces intimate and historically inspired interpretations of music composed before 1840 for Portland, OR audiences. Learn more about their music and its significance in the current world by following and read their informative blog.
